reasoning_traces.think:
The motif trace enforces temporal causality by ensuring all forecasted values derive from feed rows strictly anterior to game time, preventing lookahead bias. The may_publish gate applies a fail-closed logic to prevent publication of data with null or stale provenance, maintaining data integrity. The sweep gate filters forecasts using probabilistic thresholds (|p - 0.5|) and performance metrics such as Brier score and beat-the-close, aligning with conformal prediction principles. These three operators form a triadic constraint system: temporal consistency (motif_trace), data reliability (may_publish), and probabilistic validity (sweep_gate). Failure in any layer leads to rejection of the forecast. Dualities emerge in that motif_trace ensures causality while sweep_gate ensures calibration, and may_publish ensures trustworthiness. The system avoids synthetic data and zero-filling, enforcing empirical grounding. The layered architecture allows for retroactive validation and adaptive filtering.
